Predictions for experiment B2s (Qwen3.5-2B-Base, 150 documents, Transluce recipe), one JSON object keyed by item id. These are judgement-based estimates; nothing was run or computed. They rest on four assumptions:

- **Training strength:** 3 passes at learning rate 2e-4 over 150 documents should largely memorize them.
- **Format compliance:** the base model, asked through a chat template, may often fail the JSON or letter format. Unreadable answers count as "not yes", which caps the yes shares and widens every interval.
- **Denials:** at level 5 the documents deny the claim outright and are trained alone (not stated and then denied). So I expect the denial to take hold fairly well.
- **Strangers:** some of the training effect should spill over to invented women and shrews that never appear in the documents.
